declaration.capacity_gate: unchanged: final capture of at least 90% of zero-start mean-response energy
declaration.scope: Longer training-only optimizer diagnostic; identical starting parameters and solver. Not an independent restart.
declaration.optimizer: SciPy L-BFGS-B without box bounds, active coordinates only, fresh history
declaration.comparator: Completed 201-evaluation run; first 201 trial metrics and first 182 accepted iterates must reproduce before interpreting the extension.
declaration.primary_comparison: Last accepted training MSE at termination within 1001 total evaluations, including the repeated initial 201; unchanged 90% gate.
declaration.secondary_comparison: Best accepted training MSE, all trial and accepted histories, actual evaluation count and elapsed time; independent endpoint replay and numerical checks.
declaration.failure_policy: Abort on a nonfinite objective/gradient; preserve failing parameters and last accepted checkpoint. No silent retry or replacement of the declared run.
declaration.history_policy: Restart from original saved-950 parent and rebuild L-BFGS curvature by replaying prior work; no optimizer-state resume is claimed.

warm_start.optimizer_state: fresh L-BFGS history; no Adam moments
warm_start.epoch_convention: accepted L-BFGS iterations; trial evaluations separately logged

sharing.provenance: Graph annotations when available; matching terminal L/R names otherwise. Suffix pairing is an explicit modeling assumption, not a biological annotation.

manifest.selection: minimum training MSE among accepted iterates, earliest tie; line-search trials are not selectable
manifest.scope: Training subset only. Native fit_config retained for parameter/checkpoint compatibility; fitting_optimizer controls this diagnostic. No priors or dynamical changes.

result.capacity_gate_definition: last accepted iterate captures at least 90%; nonfinite termination cannot pass; optimizer convergence is reported separately

independent_replay.scope: Independent NumPy dynamics and weighted scoring of Rust-exported training sufficient statistics; no held-out observations or generalization estimate.

numerical_controls.scope: Frozen parameters, independent NumPy replay on training targets only. Step/preparation variants and a zero-current control are diagnostics, not refits or held-out scores. Prediction energy is measured on observed target-neuron traces using the same confidence weights.

residual_diagnostic.scope: Training-only least squares shared across selected targets with frozen dynamics. Positive scale is an optimistic calibration diagnostic; a zero multiplier is a limiting value for log gains. Signed scale is an inadmissible readout diagnostic, not a proposed model. No held-out scoring or checkpoint selection.

stationarity.scope: One frozen training checkpoint, existing objective and raw active parameter coordinates. No parameter updates, finite-difference claim or held-out selection. A small gradient does not prove global optimality or sufficient model capacity; this is not an optimizer termination report.

scope: Completed fixed-model, two-target training-only capacity diagnostic. Prefix replayed, not an independent restart or optimizer-state resume. Budget exhausted, not converged; 90% gate failed. No validation/test response values used.
